If you can confirm procurement timelines and who needs to sign, I’ll route MAP + pricing for internal approval.

Next steps:
1) Liam — confirm procurement approver(s) and preferred signature route by end of week.
2) Mosaic — review attached MAP and highlight any missing milestones.
3) Redwood internal — Marissa/Grace: can you please review pricing/credit ask and advise on exec route?

Thanks — attaching MAP and SOW.
